# solver-2022: generated files

Built artifacts, never edited by hand. The site's rule is that everything written by hand is
TypeScript; JavaScript generated by a tool lives only in declared folders like this one, with its
origin and a SHA-256 per file. `tests/unit/artifacts.test.ts` checks the hashes below, and the
TypeScript-only guard excludes this folder and nothing else.

## What it is

Pablo's falling-blocks solver from CI0117 (Universidad de Costa Rica, 2022), serial and pthreads
versions, compiled to WebAssembly so Crease No. 002 can run the 2022 code on the reader's device
(M7). The C source stays private: it is the solution to a course assignment.

Changes from the 2022 code, all in the source repository's `solver-2022/README.md`: printing and the
per-level output files removed; a use after free, two buffer overflows and the memory leaks fixed;
the course's piece file replaced by one written for the port. The search, the threads created and
joined on every level, the mutex and the column-by-column split are as they were.

## How it was built

- Source: `crease-pattern-studio`, commit `8fa2217`, folder `solver-2022`.
- Tool: Emscripten 7.0.0 (emsdk), Closure enabled.
- Command: `./build.sh release` (two consecutive builds produce the same bytes).
